title: Customer Service Administrator
description:
Role Details

Role: Property Manager

Location: Shrewsbury

Salary: £28,000-£31,000

Role Overview

Durrant Talent Solutions is proud to be partnering with a leading national residential managing agent in the search for a Property Manager to join their Shrewsbury team.

This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Property Manager to take ownership of a residential portfolio, delivering exceptional property management services while building strong relationships with leaseholders, residents, clients and contractors.

The successful candidate will be responsible for ensuring developments are managed to the highest professional standards, maintaining compliance, overseeing maintenance and service delivery, and providing an outstanding customer experience across their portfolio.

Role Responsibilities
- Manage a portfolio of residential leasehold developments.
- Build and maintain strong relationships with leaseholders, Resident Management Companies (RMCs), Right to Manage Companies (RTMs) and freeholder clients.
- Prepare and manage annual service charge budgets in conjunction with internal teams.
- Monitor expenditure and ensure developments are managed within approved budgets.
- Arrange, attend and chair site inspections and client meetings as required.
- Instruct, monitor and review contractors to ensure works are completed to the required standard.
- Oversee planned and reactive maintenance across the portfolio.
- Ensure compliance with all relevant health and safety legislation, including fire, asbestos, water hygiene and lift regulations.
- Work closely with internal departments including finance, compliance and customer services.
- Respond promptly and professionally to customer enquiries and resolve issues effectively.
- Ensure accurate property records are maintained and all administration is completed within agreed timescales.

Essential Experience

The successful candidate will have:
- Previous experience managing a residential block management portfolio.
- A good understanding of residential leasehold legislation and property management best practice.
- Excellent communication and relationship-building skills.
- Strong organisational skills with the ability to manage a varied workload.
- A proactive and customer-focused approach.
- The ability to prioritise tasks and work independently.
- Competent IT skills, including Microsoft Office.
- A full UK driving licence (where required).

Desirable Experience
- TPI qualified or working towards level 3
- Experience using property management software such as Qube, TRAMPS, Propman or similar.

Equal Opportunities Statement

Durrant Talent Solutions is committed to promoting equality, diversity and inclusion throughout the recruitment process. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified individuals regardless of age, disability, gender reassignment, marriage and civil partnership, pregnancy and maternity, race, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected under the Equality Act 2010. Selection decisions are based solely on skills, experience, qualifications and suitability for the role.

Due to the high volume of applications received, we may only be able to contact candidates who are shortlisted. If you do not hear from us within 7 days of submitting your application, please assume your application has been unsuccessful on this occasion.

title: Customer Support Administrator
description:
Amour Recruitment are proud to be working for this well-established business who due to growth is seeking a Customer Service Administrator to join their busy team based in Shrewsbury.

Key Responsibilities:
- Answer incoming calls and emails dealing with requests from clients and customers that require a routine response whilst directing more complex issues via calls or emails to the appropriate person/team.
- Keeping the main data base up to date and uploading new documents
- Oversee diary for appointments
- General administration.

Personal Requirements:
- Excellent communication skills
- Confident with Word & Excel and mail merges
- Previous customer service experience within an office environment

Benefits include:
- 22 days holiday, plus bank holidays
- Career progression

Hours: Monday to Friday, (Apply online only) with 1 hour for lunch

Salary: £25,385

If you are looking to work for a company that offers stability and progression, then we would love to hear from you! Apply now are call Amour Recruitment for more information

title: Service Advisor
description:
SERVICE ADVISOR
Location: Shrewsbury
Salary: £29,000 Basic Salary OTE £35,000
Hours: Monday to Friday, 8:00am - 6:00pm (One Early Finish Per Week) Saturdays, 8:00am - 2:00pm on a Rota
Job Type: Full-Time, Permanent

Looking for a role where your customer service skills are recognised, your earning potential is rewarded, and your career can continue to progress?
If you're an experienced Service Advisor looking to join a successful main dealership, this is an excellent opportunity to become part of a professional and supportive aftersales team. Offering a competitive salary, achievable bonus, excellent employee benefits, and genuine opportunities for career progression, this role is ideal for someone who enjoys delivering exceptional customer service in a fast-paced environment.

As the first point of contact for customers, you'll play a key role in ensuring every customer receives a first-class experience while helping to maximise workshop efficiency and aftersales performance.

WHAT'S IN IT FOR YOU?
£29,000 Basic Salary
OTE £35,000
Generous Annual Leave, Increasing with Length of Service
Enhanced Family Leave
Eyecare Vouchers
Smart Health - 24/7 GP & Wellbeing Support
Dental Insurance
Optional Critical Illness Cover
Discounted Gym Memberships
Travel Insurance
Home & Technology Vouchers
Retail & Lifestyle Discounts
Ongoing Training & Career Development

THE ROLE
As a Service Advisor, you'll be responsible for delivering an outstanding customer experience while ensuring the efficient day-to-day operation of the service department.
Key responsibilities include:
Booking customer vehicles in for servicing, maintenance, and repairs
Ensuring efficient workshop loading by liaising closely with the workshop team
Keeping customers informed throughout the repair process
Advising customers on additional work required and associated costs
Upselling service plans, maintenance work, and aftersales products where appropriate
Preparing estimates, invoices, and service documentation accurately
Working closely with Technicians to ensure vehicles are completed on time
Delivering exceptional customer service from vehicle check-in through to collection

ABOUT YOU
We're keen to hear from candidates who can demonstrate:
Previous experience as a Service Advisor within the automotive industry
Experience using Kerridge, 1 Link, Pinnacle, or a similar Dealer Management System (DMS)
A proven track record of upselling additional work, service plans, and aftersales products
Excellent communication and customer service skills
Strong organisational skills with the ability to prioritise workload effectively
A positive, professional, and team-focused attitude
Full UK Manual Driving Licence (subject to licence checks)
Right to work in the UK (sponsorship is not available)

APPLY TODAY
This is an excellent opportunity to join a dealership that values exceptional customer service, invests in its people, and offers genuine opportunities for long-term career progression within a supportive and rewarding working environment.
If you're an experienced Service Advisor looking for your next challenge, we'd love to hear from you.

Interested in finding out more? Apply today or contact Kieran at Auto Skills for a confidential discussion about this Service Advisor opportunity, quoting job reference 54760.
